---
name: Run this course in my town
about: Ask to host the 2-day Sats On The Road course where you live
title: "[TOWN] Run the course in: "
labels: ["host-request"]
---

Thank you for wanting to bring the course to your town. Fill in what you can. It is fine to leave a line blank if you are not sure yet, just write "not sure" and we will help.

**Town and country**
<!-- Where would the course run? -->

**Partner or community**
<!-- Is a local Bitcoin community, school, co-op, or group helping? Name them if so. -->

**Proposed dates**
<!-- Even a rough month helps. The course runs over 2 days. -->

**Venue**
<!-- Where could the 2 days happen? A room, a community hall, a church, a school. Does it have power and seating? -->

**Nearby market**
<!-- Day 1 ends with buying something real in sats. Is there a market or a few shops close by where traders might take part? -->

**Languages needed**
<!-- Which languages should the materials and the teaching be in? -->

**Anything else**
<!-- Numbers you expect, local rules we should know, phones and SIM access, or any question you have. -->
